  t222_staged_replay: {run: "T222_TZ_PROOF=1 T222_TZ_PHASE=replay go test ./internal/usecase -run '^TestT222ActualStagedReplay$' -count=1 -v -timeout=3m", requires_approval: true, required_env: [T222_TZ_DATABASE_URL, T222_TZ_SEED_FILE], optional_env: [T222_TZ_RESULT_FILE], database: remediation_t222_tz_integration_proof, note: "Root-only serial actual PostgreSQL replay in a separate Go test process. No migrations/reset/cleanup or live sibling services; test skips without proof gate."}
  run: {run: go run ./cmd/ms-go-tz-planner, requires_approval: true}
  migrate_up:
    run: |
      set -eu
      for migration in db/migrations/*.up.sql; do
        psql "$DATABASE_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$migration"
      done
    requires_approval: true
